review_sections.content: Amira Belhaj (CEO) — curriculum designer, 6 years. Karim Mansour (CTO) — mobile developer, 4 years.
$2.4B MENA EdTech market by 2027. 28% CAGR. Source: RedSeer 2023.
B2B SaaS. Annual school licenses + per-student seat fees. CAC $1,200 / LTV $8,400.
3 paid pilots. 1,400 students. 2 LOIs signed. Ministry of Education meeting confirmed.
$18,000 ARR current. $240,000 projected year 1. $400,000 funding ask.
50% female founding team. No board disclosed. No governance documents provided.
Competitors: Edraak, Noon Academy, Google Classroom. Differentiation: Arabic-first, Tunisian syllabus.
